MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between the parties as of the Effective Date. The
specific services to be performed are described in one or more Statements of Work ("SOW") executed under this Agreement;
in the event of a conflict between this Agreement and a SOW, this Agreement controls unless the SOW expressly states
otherwise.

Section 2. Term and Renewal. The initial term of this Agreement is two (2) years, commencing on January 1, 2026 (the
"Effective Date"). Thereafter, the Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party
provides sixty (60) days' prior written notice of non-renewal.

Section 3. Fees and Payment. Fees for the services are $12,000 per month, invoiced monthly and payable net thirty (30)
days from the invoice date. Fees are exclusive of applicable taxes.

Section 5. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New
York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

Section 7. Limitation of Liability. Except for breaches of confidentiality, neither party's aggregate liability under
this Agreement will exceed the total fees paid by the Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise
to the claim.

Section 9. Confidentiality. Each party will protect the other's Confidential Information using no less than reasonable
care. This Section survives termination.
AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Amendment No. 1 ("Amendment") modifies the Master Services Agreement between the parties. Capitalized terms not
defined here have the meaning given in the Agreement. Where this Amendment conflicts with the Agreement, this Amendment
controls.

1. Section 2 (Term and Renewal) is amended so that the notice period required to prevent automatic renewal is changed
from sixty (60) days to ninety (90) days' prior written notice.

2. Section 5 (Governing Law) is amended in its entirety: this Agreement is now governed by the laws of the State of
Delaware, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

3. A new late-payment term is added: invoices not paid when due accrue a late charge of one and one-half percent (1.5%)
per month on the outstanding balance until paid.

4. Except as expressly amended above, all other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
STATEMENT OF WORK NO. 1

This Statement of Work ("SOW") is executed under, and incorporates by reference, the Master Services Agreement between
the parties. Capitalized terms not defined in this SOW have the meaning given in the Agreement.

Scope. The Provider will design and deliver a data-integration platform consisting of three deliverables: (a) a landing
and staging pipeline; (b) a reconciliation and quality-gate layer; and (c) a read API with published documentation.

Delivery Milestones. The work is delivered in three milestones — Milestone 1 (staging pipeline), Milestone 2
(reconciliation layer), and Milestone 3 (read API). Acceptance of each milestone is subject to the Client's review
within ten (10) business days of delivery.

Milestone Payments. Fees for this SOW are payable against milestones as follows: forty percent (40%) on acceptance of
Milestone 1, thirty percent (30%) on acceptance of Milestone 2, and thirty percent (30%) on acceptance of Milestone 3.
These milestone payments are in addition to the recurring monthly fees under the Agreement.

Personnel. The Provider will assign a technical lead for the duration of this SOW.
DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM

This Data Processing Addendum ("DPA") supplements the Master Services Agreement and applies whenever the Provider
processes Personal Data on behalf of the Client. In the event of a conflict between this DPA and the Agreement with
respect to the processing of Personal Data, this DPA controls.

Security Incident Notification. The Provider will notify the Client of a confirmed personal-data breach without undue
delay and in any event within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of it.

Sub-processors. The Provider will not engage any sub-processor to process Personal Data without the Client's prior
written consent. A current list of approved sub-processors is maintained on request.

Return and Deletion. Upon termination or expiry of the Agreement, the Provider will, at the Client's choice, return or
delete all Personal Data within thirty (30) days, except where retention is required by law.

International Transfers. The Provider will not transfer Personal Data outside the country of collection without an
approved transfer mechanism.

MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between the parties as of the Effective Date. The
specific services to be performed are described in one or more Statements of Work ("SOW") executed under this Agreement;
in the event of a conflict between this Agreement and a SOW, this Agreement controls unless the SOW expressly states
otherwise.

Section 2. Term and Renewal. The initial term of this Agreement is two (2) years, commencing on January 1, 2026 (the
"Effective Date"). Thereafter, the Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party
provides sixty (60) days' prior written notice of non-renewal.

Section 3. Fees and Payment. Fees for the services are $12,000 per month, invoiced monthly and payable net thirty (30)
days from the invoice date. Fees are exclusive of applicable taxes.

Section 5. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New
York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

Section 7. Limitation of Liability. Except for breaches of confidentiality, neither party's aggregate liability under
this Agreement will exceed the total fees paid by the Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise
to the claim.

Section 9. Confidentiality. Each party will protect the other's Confidential Information using no less than reasonable
care. This Section survives termination.

Scope. The Provider will design and deliver a data-integration platform consisting of three deliverables: (a) a landing

This Data Processing Addendum ("DPA") supplements the Master Services Agreement and applies whenever the Provider
processes Personal Data on behalf of the Client. In the event of a conflict between this DPA and the Agreement with
respect to the processing of Personal Data, this DPA controls.

Security Incident Notification. The Provider will notify the Client of a confirmed personal-data breach without undue
delay and in any event within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of it.

Sub-processors. The Provider will not engage any sub-processor to process Personal Data without the Client's prior
written consent. A current list of approved sub-processors is maintained on request.

Return and Deletion. Upon termination or expiry of the Agreement, the Provider will, at the Client's choice, return or
delete all Personal Data within thirty (30) days, except where retention is required by law.

International Transfers. The Provider will not transfer Personal Data outside the country of collection without an
approved transfer mechanism.

MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between the parties as of the Effective Date. The
specific services to be performed are described in one or more Statements of Work ("SOW") executed under this Agreement;
in the event of a conflict between this Agreement and a SOW, this Agreement controls unless the SOW expressly states
otherwise.

Section 2. Term and Renewal. The initial term of this Agreement is two (2) years, commencing on January 1, 2026 (the
"Effective Date"). Thereafter, the Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party
provides sixty (60) days' prior written notice of non-renewal.

Section 3. Fees and Payment. Fees for the services are $12,000 per month, invoiced monthly and payable net thirty (30)
days from the invoice date. Fees are exclusive of applicable taxes.

Section 5. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New
York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

Section 7. Limitation of Liability. Except for breaches of confidentiality, neither party's aggregate liability under
this Agreement will exceed the total fees paid by the Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise
to the claim.

Section 9. Confidentiality. Each party will protect the other's Confidential Information using no less than reasonable
care. This Section survives termination.
AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Amendment No. 1 ("Amendment") modifies the Master Services Agreement between the parties. Capitalized terms not
defined here have the meaning given in the Agreement. Where this Amendment conflicts with the Agreement, this Amendment
controls.

1. Section 2 (Term and Renewal) is amended so that the notice period required to prevent automatic renewal is changed
from sixty (60) days to ninety (90) days' prior written notice.

2. Section 5 (Governing Law) is amended in its entirety: this Agreement is now governed by the laws of the State of
Delaware, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

3. A new late-payment term is added: invoices not paid when due accrue a late charge of one and one-half percent (1.5%)
per month on the outstanding balance until paid.

4. Except as expressly amended above, all other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
STATEMENT OF WORK NO. 1

This Statement of Work ("SOW") is executed under, and incorporates by reference, the Master Services Agreement between
the parties. Capitalized terms not defined in this SOW have the meaning given in the Agreement.

Scope. The Provider will design and deliver a data-integration platform consisting of three deliverables: (a) a landing
and staging pipeline; (b) a reconciliation and quality-gate layer; and (c) a read API with published documentation.

Delivery Milestones. The work is delivered in three milestones — Milestone 1 (staging pipeline), Milestone 2
(reconciliation layer), and Milestone 3 (read API). Acceptance of each milestone is subject to the Client's review
within ten (10) business days of delivery.

Milestone Payments. Fees for this SOW are payable against milestones as follows: forty percent (40%) on acceptance of
Milestone 1, thirty percent (30%) on acceptance of Milestone 2, and thirty percent (30%) on acceptance of Milestone 3.
These milestone payments are in addition to the recurring monthly fees under the Agreement.

Personnel. The Provider will assign a technical lead for the duration of this SOW.
DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM

This Data Processing Addendum ("DPA") supplements the Master Services Agreement and applies whenever the Provider
processes Personal Data on behalf of the Client. In the event of a conflict between this DPA and the Agreement with
respect to the processing of Personal Data, this DPA controls.

Security Incident Notification. The Provider will notify the Client of a confirmed personal-data breach without undue
delay and in any event within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of it.

Sub-processors. The Provider will not engage any sub-processor to process Personal Data without the Client's prior
written consent. A current list of approved sub-processors is maintained on request.

Return and Deletion. Upon termination or expiry of the Agreement, the Provider will, at the Client's choice, return or
delete all Personal Data within thirty (30) days, except where retention is required by law.

International Transfers. The Provider will not transfer Personal Data outside the country of collection without an
approved transfer mechanism.

This Master Services Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between the parties as of the Effective Date. The
specific services to be performed are described in one or more Statements of Work ("SOW") executed under this Agreement;
in the event of a conflict between this Agreement and a SOW, this Agreement controls unless the SOW expressly states
otherwise.

Section 2. Term and Renewal. The initial term of this Agreement is two (2) years, commencing on January 1, 2026 (the
"Effective Date"). Thereafter, the Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party
provides sixty (60) days' prior written notice of non-renewal.

Section 3. Fees and Payment. Fees for the services are $12,000 per month, invoiced monthly and payable net thirty (30)
days from the invoice date. Fees are exclusive of applicable taxes.

Section 5. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New
York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

Section 7. Limitation of Liability. Except for breaches of confidentiality, neither party's aggregate liability under
this Agreement will exceed the total fees paid by the Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise
to the claim.

Section 9. Confidentiality. Each party will protect the other's Confidential Information using no less than reasonable
care. This Section survives termination.

AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Amendment No. 1 ("Amendment") modifies the Master Services Agreement between the parties. Capitalized terms not
defined here have the meaning given in the Agreement. Where this Amendment conflicts with the Agreement, this Amendment
controls.

1. Section 2 (Term and Renewal) is amended so that the notice period required to prevent automatic renewal is changed
from sixty (60) days to ninety (90) days' prior written notice.

2. Section 5 (Governing Law) is amended in its entirety: this Agreement is now governed by the laws of the State of
Delaware, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles.

3. A new late-payment term is added: invoices not paid when due accrue a late charge of one and one-half percent (1.5%)
per month on the outstanding balance until paid.

4. Except as expressly amended above, all other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
sources.SOW No. 1:
STATEMENT OF WORK NO. 1

This Statement of Work ("SOW") is executed under, and incorporates by reference, the Master Services Agreement between
the parties. Capitalized terms not defined in this SOW have the meaning given in the Agreement.

Scope. The Provider will design and deliver a data-integration platform consisting of three deliverables: (a) a landing
and staging pipeline; (b) a reconciliation and quality-gate layer; and (c) a read API with published documentation.

Delivery Milestones. The work is delivered in three milestones — Milestone 1 (staging pipeline), Milestone 2
(reconciliation layer), and Milestone 3 (read API). Acceptance of each milestone is subject to the Client's review
within ten (10) business days of delivery.

Milestone Payments. Fees for this SOW are payable against milestones as follows: forty percent (40%) on acceptance of
Milestone 1, thirty percent (30%) on acceptance of Milestone 2, and thirty percent (30%) on acceptance of Milestone 3.
These milestone payments are in addition to the recurring monthly fees under the Agreement.

Personnel. The Provider will assign a technical lead for the duration of this SOW.
sources.Data Processing Addendum:
DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM

This Data Processing Addendum ("DPA") supplements the Master Services Agreement and applies whenever the Provider
processes Personal Data on behalf of the Client. In the event of a conflict between this DPA and the Agreement with
respect to the processing of Personal Data, this DPA controls.

Security Incident Notification. The Provider will notify the Client of a confirmed personal-data breach without undue
delay and in any event within seventy-two (72) hours of becoming aware of it.

Sub-processors. The Provider will not engage any sub-processor to process Personal Data without the Client's prior
written consent. A current list of approved sub-processors is maintained on request.

Return and Deletion. Upon termination or expiry of the Agreement, the Provider will, at the Client's choice, return or
delete all Personal Data within thirty (30) days, except where retention is required by law.

International Transfers. The Provider will not transfer Personal Data outside the country of collection without an
approved transfer mechanism.
